The Force is especially strong this holiday season. With the 50th anniversary of “ Star Wars ” approaching in 2027, Disney and Lucasfilm are preparing for a yearlong celebration of the franchise, complete with new merchandise, immersive experiences and a theatrical re-release of George Lucas’ original 1977 film.

The companies officially kicked off the countdown in November, unveiling an ambitious slate of anniversary collections from longtime partners and new collaborators. Lego is releasing seven commemorative sets on Jan. 1 of next year, spanning collectible helmets, vehicles and display models inspired by the original trilogy. Hasbro, meanwhile, has opened preorders for new figures across its Black Series, Vintage Collection and Retro Collection lines. The larger rollout will also see collaborations with brands including Adidas, Aston Martin and Steinway & Sons.

blocks.text: But fans don’t have to wait until next year to get their hands on new “Star Wars” merchandise. The 2026 release of “ The Mandalorian and Grogu” has brought a fresh assortment of collectibles, Lego builds and limited-edition physical releases, while new books offer behind-the-scenes looks at the franchise’s expanding cinematic universe.
There are also plenty of gifts for fans who prefer to wear their fandom, from Padmé Amidala-inspired handbags to playful Grogu accessories.
Below, find the best new “Star Wars” gifts to shop in 2026.

blocks.alt: The Best Star Wars Gifts for Fans: Merch, Collectibles, Books, Toys

blocks.text: Lego Star Wars Mandalorian N-1 Starfighter

Lego’s latest Ultimate Collector Series release recreates Din Djarin’s modified N-1 Starfighter from “The Mandalorian” in 1,809 pieces. The intricate display model features authentic details from the series, along with minifigures of the Mandalorian and Grogu.

blocks.alt: The Best Star Wars Gifts for Fans: Merch, Collectibles, Books, Toys

blocks.text: Lego Star Wars Advent Calendar

Count down to Christmas with LEGO’s annual “Star Wars” Advent Calendar, featuring 24 miniature builds, character figures and holiday-themed surprises. It’s a festive gift for younger fans and longtime collectors alike. Check out more pop-culture advent calendars to shop this year here.

blocks.alt: The Best Star Wars Gifts for Fans: Merch, Collectibles, Books, Toys

blocks.text: The Art of Star Wars: Andor (The Complete Series)

Go behind the scenes of one of the most acclaimed entries in the “Star Wars” franchise with this comprehensive art book, featuring concept illustrations, costume designs and production artwork from “Andor.”

blocks.alt: The Best Star Wars Gifts for Fans: Merch, Collectibles, Books, Toys

blocks.text: Thrawn (Deluxe Edition)

One of the most formidable villains in the “Star Wars” universe gets the deluxe treatment in this special edition of Timothy Zahn’s bestselling novel. Released in October, the 448-page hardcover chronicles Grand Admiral Thrawn’s rise through the Imperial ranks and comes housed in a collectible slipcase with a Star Destroyer-shaped cutout, illustrated endpapers, sprayed edges and a satin ribbon bookmark.

blocks.alt: The Best Star Wars Gifts for Fans: Merch, Collectibles, Books, Toys

blocks.text: Star Wars Icons: Vader

Few movie villains have had the cultural staying power of Darth Vader. This collector’s book traces the Sith Lord’s evolution into one of cinema’s most recognizable characters, exploring his design, on-screen appearances and enduring influence on the franchise. A handsome addition to any “Star Wars” fan’s coffee table book collection.

blocks.alt: The Best Star Wars Gifts for Fans: Merch, Collectibles, Books, Toys

blocks.text: The Art of Star Wars: Mandalorian and Grogu

Get an inside look at the making of “The Mandalorian and Grogu” with this new 256-page coffee-table book from Lucasfilm creative art manager Phil Szostak. Featuring original concept art, character sketches, production designs and interviews with the film’s cast and creative team, the hardcover offers a behind-the-scenes look at the franchise’s first theatrical release in seven years.

blocks.alt: The Best Star Wars Gifts for Fans: Merch, Collectibles, Books, Toys

blocks.text: K-2SO Premium Electronic Head With Lights and Sounds

The sarcastic security droid from “Rogue One” gets the collector treatment with this electronic replica of K-2SO’s head. Featuring character phrases, illuminated details and sound effects, the display piece makes a fitting gift for fans of the 2016 film, which celebrates its 10th anniversary this year.

blocks.alt: The Best Star Wars Gifts for Fans: Merch, Collectibles, Books, Toys

blocks.text: Ezra Legacy Light Saber Set

Fans of “Star Wars Rebels” can get their hands on two of Ezra Bridger’s signature lightsaber hilts with this limited-edition collectible set. Released as part of Disney’s 2026 Life Day merchandise rollout, the replicas feature authentic sound effects and illuminate in blue and green when attached to separately sold blades. Both come packaged in an illustrated display box that plays scenes from the animated series.

blocks.alt: The Best Star Wars Gifts for Fans: Merch, Collectibles, Books, Toys

blocks.text: Star Wars Electronic Dejarik Board Game

Bring the Millennium Falcon’s famous holographic chess game home with this electronic version of Dejarik, the fictional strategy game first seen in “A New Hope.” Complete with sculpted creature pieces, lights and sound effects, the collectible board game recreates one of the original trilogy’s most memorable scenes.

blocks.alt: The Best Star Wars Gifts for Fans: Merch, Collectibles, Books, Toys

blocks.text: Grogu Animatronic Figure

The closest thing to having a real Baby Yoda at home, Hasbro’s life-size Ultimate Grogu animatronic features moving arms, legs and ears, blinking eyes and a mouth that opens and closes. Equipped with sensors and three interactive modes, the remarkably lifelike collectible can respond to its surroundings, make sounds and even wave. The figure also comes with a cookie accessory. Available for preorder, with standard editions shipping in 2027.

blocks.alt: The Best Star Wars Gifts for Fans: Merch, Collectibles, Books, Toys

blocks.text: The Mandalorian & Grogu – Beskar Collector’s Edition (Steelbook) – 4K + Blu-ray + Digital

Celebrate the Mandalorian’s big-screen debut with this premium physical edition of “The Mandalorian and Grogu.” The collector’s set includes the film on 4K UHD in a limited-edition SteelBook, along with exclusive metal art posters and collectible packaging inspired by the bounty hunter’s signature Beskar armor.

blocks.alt: The Best Star Wars Gifts for Fans: Merch, Collectibles, Books, Toys

blocks.text: Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu – 4K Ultra HD SteelBook [Blu-Ray]

Bring Din Djarin and Grogu’s latest adventure home with this limited-edition 4K Ultra HD SteelBook, featuring collectible artwork and a Blu-ray copy of the film. The physical release also includes director Jon Favreau’s commentary and behind-the-scenes featurettes exploring the movie’s elaborate environments, creatures and production. A fitting addition to any “Star Wars” fan’s physical media collection.

blocks.alt: The Best Star Wars Gifts for Fans: Merch, Collectibles, Books, Toys

blocks.text: Star Wars Zero Company

Set during the Clone Wars, “Star Wars Zero Company” puts players in command of an elite squad of operatives navigating a galaxy at war. Developed by Bit Reactor in collaboration with Lucasfilm Games, the single-player tactical game combines turn-based combat with an original storyline featuring new and familiar characters. Released in August for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and PC, it’s an ideal gift for strategy-minded gamers.

blocks.alt: The Best Star Wars Gifts for Fans: Merch, Collectibles, Books, Toys

blocks.text: Star Wars: Galactic Racer

The “Star Wars” universe gets a new racing adventure in “Galactic Racer,” which sends players speeding through the Outer Rim in high-stakes competitions. Featuring vehicles and environments inspired by the galaxy far, far away, the game is a particularly good pick for fans who prefer the franchise’s adrenaline-fueled action to its lightsaber duels.

blocks.alt: The Best Star Wars Gifts for Fans: Merch, Collectibles, Books, Toys

blocks.text: Neiman Marcus Star Wars Experience

This one-of-a-kind “Star Wars” experience, unveiled as part of Neiman Marcus’s Fantasy Gift Guide, includes private access to Lucasfilm and Industrial Light & Magic, custom lightsabers and four VIP tickets to an upcoming “Star Wars” world premiere and afterparty. The six-figure package arrives ahead of the franchise’s 50th anniversary in 2027 , when Disney and Lucasfilm will release Shawn Levy’s highly anticipated “Star Wars: Starfighter.”

blocks.alt: The Best Star Wars Gifts for Fans: Merch, Collectibles, Books, Toys

blocks.text: Icons Unearthed: Star Wars – Hardcover

This new Star Wars book features an oral history into the biggest sci-fi franchise of all time. The book includes exclusive interviews with Anthony Daniels, Billy Dee Williams, Paul Hirsch, Phil Tippett, Rick Baker, Ken Ralston, John Dykstra and more. The biggest interview: new details from Marcia Lucas, the ex-wife of George Lucas, who is credited with editing the Star Wars trilogy.

Meddle with your opponents by forcing them to face off against Jedi and heroes like Luke Skywalker, Princess Leia, and The Mandalorian.

For fans looking to explore beyond the Skywalker saga, “Star Wars: The High Republic” offers an expansive collection of novels and comics set centuries before the events of “The Phantom Menace.” Featuring a new generation of Jedi Knights, political intrigue and formidable enemies, the interconnected stories explore the Republic at the height of its power.

Star Wars: Tales From the Galaxy’s Edge

blocks.alt: Galaxy's Edge Oculus Star Wars Gifts

blocks.text: Did the pandemic halt your plans to visit Disneyland or Disney World’s Galaxy’s Edge? Have faith young padawan, all you need is the Oculus Quest 2 paired with the “ Star Wars : Tales from the Galaxy’s Edge” experience, and you’ll be inside the galaxy far, far away from the comfort of your home. The brand new Oculus platform will be dropping this holiday season and due to the lower storage capabilities, Oculus has dropped the price down considerably.

“Galaxy’s Edge” takes players to planet Batuu so they can explore the cantina, the outer lands and even run into some familiar faces. You’ll join classic characters like R2-D2 and C-3PO (voiced by the original “Star Wars” actor Anthony Daniels) to fight off Guavian Death Gang cell leader Tara Rashin (Debra Wilson) and even the odd flying creature. Additional characters you’ll interact with include Seezelslak (voiced by Bobby Moynihan) and Jedi Master Yoda (voiced by Frank Oz). Lucasfilm’s immersive entertainment experience “Galaxy’s Edge” is currently available on the Oculus Quest platform priced at $24.99.

blocks.text: It may take place in a galaxy far, far away, but there are a lot of lessons we can glean from “Star Wars” in our everyday lives as well. This “New York Times” best-seller explores topics like family, rebellion and redemption, as it pertains to the hit film franchise, and our current society. It also touches on themes of power and political dynamics, using “Star Wars” to illustrate why some people are born to succeed — while others are set up to fail. A surprisingly stimulating read, “The World According to Star Wars” will help you see one of the most popular stories of all time in a whole new way.
